records.oteryn: Global low-level bonus: 100% through level 2, decreasing by 2 1/12 percentage points per level to 0% at level 50. Added to the daily XP boost after Prey and before stamina; each modifier step truncates to an integer.
records.reference: Global: TibiaWiki Experience Point, revision 1161628, Actual XP bonus table (https://tibia.fandom.com/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&revids=1161628&rvprop=ids%7Ccontent&format=json). Crystal 201189f:data/events/scripts/player.lua uses a configurable flat 50% through level 50 instead.

records.oteryn: The thresholds are derived from the public formula in exact integers and have not been checked against the official table.
records.reference: The official tibia.com experience table is the reference; the public formula is a regression hypothesis (Global Reference checkpoint 2026-09-09 9.3).

records.oteryn: Kill XP applies Prey, then the DAILYFX +50% boost, then stamina. Day 7 activates 10 minutes for Free or 30 minutes for Premium. DAILYFX persists a server wall-clock interval; offline time counts, unlike Canary's hunting-time countdown.
records.reference: Stamina and experience boosts change the experience a kill awards.

records.oteryn: Death never changes skill levels, magic level or their progress, in PvE or PvP, with or without blessings (D58 / baseline difference 2; NIGHT-W1 decision 19 supersedes SKILLS-0 section 3.6).
records.reference: Global death can reduce skill and magic-level progress (characters.md 5.1.11).

records.oteryn: DAILY-EFFECTS-1 owner decision: day-3 Free 1 / Premium 3 wildcards; day-7 Free 10 / Premium 30 minutes at +50%. Account + World wildcard balance retains PREY-0's cap 52 and records uncredited excess. Existing Oteryn item rewards and seven-day schedule remain unchanged.
records.reference: canary:data/modules/scripts/daily_reward/daily_reward.lua:120-125 grants Free 1 / Premium 2 on day 3; :146-151 grants 10 / 30 boost minutes; :491-492 activates +50%. crystal:data/modules/scripts/daily_reward/daily_reward.lua:120-125 and :146-151 agree.
